svg.title: A better consumer layout must repay its conversion cost
svg.text: A better consumer layout must repay its conversion cost
View: shape and strides change; existing bytes remain
A transpose view does not automatically create a packed physical transpose.
Materialize → completed publication → K valid consumers
Converted storage adds bytes and dependencies; a changed source version invalidates old copies.
Compare complete routes at the same required output boundary
Direct: Kd. Converted: C + Kp (+ required return-layout cost R).
Constructed costs C = 12 μs, d = 8 μs, p = 3 μs: strict improvement starts at K = 3.
Adding R = 4 μs shifts improvement to K = 4. These are unmeasured arithmetic examples.
